messages:
remy: Planning a small perf microblast 6.2.0 -> target change window Mon 07:00 PT. Need short RN for internal, pin snippet, canary cadence, and clear rollback steps. @kai ops lead?

kai: I'll take ops. Proposed canary: 5% (15m) -> 30% (20m) -> 100% ramp. Gates: error-rate, p95 latency, and a quick QA prompt sample. On failure: immediate abort + fallback to 6.1.9 and disable new_kernel flag.

ana: I'll draft RN copy: one-line summary + 2 bullets (what changed, impact) + rollback line. Will keep it short for #all-hands copy.

deploybot: Preflight checks OK for release 6.2.0

- infra: OK
- migrations: none
- smoke: 10/10 PASS
- canary hooks: configured

kai: Ops runbook snippet:
```
# pin version
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -d '{"service":"inference","version":"6.2.0"}'
# abort+rollback
deployctl abort --release 62099 && deployctl rollback --service inference --version 6.1.9
# toggle flag
echo 'disable new_kernel' | internal-flagctl set new_kernel off
```

ana: Draft RN microcopy:
```
6.2.0 (micro): batching/kernel tweak to reduce short-prompt tail latency (~10%). No API changes. Pin: 6.2.0. Rollback: automatic fallback to 6.1.9 and disable new_kernel if canary gates fail.
```

remy: Good. Add "telemetry off" to rollback sentence so we don't keep noisy signals. Kai: monitor first 30m; escalate to me + ana on thresholds. I'll sign off when RN posted here and tag #all-hands-announce.
